solutionSql:
(
  SELECT s.status FROM shipments s
  EXCEPT
  SELECT e.status FROM shipment_events e
)
UNION
(
  SELECT e.status FROM shipment_events e
  EXCEPT
  SELECT s.status FROM shipments s
)
ORDER BY status;

rules.howSolved: Two EXCEPT clauses, one in each direction, combined with UNION, so a value found in both feeds is excluded.
ORDER BY status ascending on the combined set.

ambiguities: 'Sort from A to Z' uses the default text collation. The values are lowercase words, one with an underscore (in_transit). I did not test other collations.
